    How it works

    What makes it different

    Real exam structures

    BECE-style papers for Basic 7 to 9, and a simple, clear format for Basic 4 to 6.

    Marking schemes included

    Laid out the way teachers expect: answer key grid, questions restated, marks shown.

    Word downloads

    Paper and marking scheme as separate files, stamped with date, time and page numbers.

    Built-in quality checks

    Marks, answer keys and curriculum coverage are checked. They support your review, they don’t replace it.
